subject: reconstructing parameter list/vector including mapped parameters?

messages.author: fd4f3538f907404b
messages.subject: reconstructing parameter list/vector including mapped parameters?
parts:
Curious whether there is an accepted idiom/standard approaches for
taking the results of a TMB fit and filling in the mapped values to get
a complete parameter vector. Is obj$env$parList() the standard way to
do this?

library(TMB)
runExample("linreg_parallel")
obj_map <- MakeADFun(data, parameters,
map=list(b=factor(NA)), DLL="linreg_parallel")
opt_map <- with(obj_map, nlminb(par, fn, gr)
obj_map$env$last.par.best
obj_map$env$parList(x=obj_map$env$last.par.best)

messages.author: 258b98968d0ad8b9
messages.subject: Re: reconstructing parameter list/vector including mapped parameters?

messages.subject: Re: [TMB users] Re: reconstructing parameter list/vector including mapped parameters?
parts:
One more quick question. If I just did obj_map$env$parList() then I
get "Error in -random : invalid argument to unary operator" (presumably
because the 'random' object in the environment is NULL because there are
no random effects in this model). I've worked around this in the
example below (working around it in the real code because there may or
may not be a random effect in the fitted model).

Is there an argument for making the built-in function more robust? Or
is there a more obvious way to make the idiom work in the presence or
absence of REs?

cheers
Ben Bolker
